set.body:
Scope

Improve evidence around the existing honest StrictFullRank policy before considering additional generalized-inverse policies.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] OLS/GLS preparation reports numerical rank, tolerance, pivot order, independent/aliased structural ColumnIds, and a documented condition estimate.
- [ ] Residual degrees of freedom reflect selected/censored/weighted rows and effective rank.
- [ ] Design rank preview and fit-time rank evidence use compatible conventions or state why they differ.
- [ ] Singular and near-singular failures identify the structural columns/subspace involved, not only a solver string.
- [ ] Compiled hypotheses record estimability decisions against the fitted row space.
- [ ] Rank-deficient comparisons use fitted values, residuals, projections, and estimable functions.
- [ ] StrictFullRank remains the default and unsupported MinimumNorm/Ridge policies remain explicit until separately implemented and justified.
- [ ] Tolerance tests include well-conditioned, scaled, nearly collinear, duplicate, zero, empty-cell, and aggressively censored designs.
- [ ] Diagnostics are stable enough for result manifests and public scenario receipts on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P2.5: enrich rank, alias, conditioning, and estimability diagnostics
